services.name: Yamaha Waverunner
services.desc: 1 Hour About New Yamaha Waverunners! There is no better time out on the water than with a jetski rental from Tierra Verde Boat Rentals! Come and explore the waters surrounding St. Pete Beach, Passagrille, Shell Island, Sand Dollar Key, Boca Ceiga Bay, Tierra Verde, and the Intracoastal Waterway. These new WaveRunners provide a safe and smooth ride for 1-2 passengers while shooting across the waters at speeds of up to 45mph! With Yamaha’s new intuitive dual throttle RiDE System, there is not a safer or more maneuverable jetski out there! Make a reservation to have an action-packed 1 Hour • All Ages • Two Person Fun Machines

services.name: 18' Keywest Center Console
services.desc: 6 Hours About Not too big and not too small, this is the perfect center console to island hop or fish the flats. Depth finder, Chart Plotter and 115hp of awesomeness sends you across the water at about 40mph and gets you where you need to be. Perfect for the couple to take to the sandbar or the father that wants to catch some fish with the kiddos. Best part… It doesn’t break the bank! Boat Information USCG rated for 4 people (Recommended for Comfort: 3 Adults) Fishing gear is allowed on this boat! Coolers and alcohol are allowed onboard. Bimini Top provides shade for most of the 6 Hours • Ages 21+

services.name: 20’ Hurricane Deckboat
services.desc: 6 Hours About Got some friends and looking for day of something to do? This 20ft Deck boat could be just right for you. Not too big and not too small, a Bimini top to provide shade for all! Head to the islands for a couple of laughs or bring a tube and have a blast! Go for an hour, or two, or four! Or make it a day and just explore! Whatever your needs this boat is just right. Make it your horse and you be the knight! Were we rhyming that whole time? Weird... Boat Information USCG rated for 10 people (Recommended for Comfort: 8-9 adults) Watersports are allowed on this boat! Large Standard 6 Hour Day • Ages 21+ • Cruise & WaterSports - 10 Seater

services.name: 22′ Key West Center Console
services.desc: 6 Hours About Newest boat in our fleet, this center console with T top is rigged for fishing or just cruising around the area. It’s 225 HP Yamaha will get you there quickly. Equipped with depth finder, chart plotter, and a large bait well, she is set up for a productive day on the water. Large 30 gallon cooler also provides extra seating, and the bow has a raised platform for better access to the fish, or for your partner to sun themselves while you catch that big one. We’ve powered her with a 225 HP Yamaha to get you there faster. Boat Information USCG rated for 7 people Standard 6 Hour Day • Ages 21+ • 225 HP Yamaha will get you there quickly!

quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: We had a great experience with our boat rental from Tierre Verde Boat Rentals!! Highly recommend it to anyone looking to rent a boat. We were given good instruction, directions, maps and suggested locations to visit and they all were spot on. Cant wait to go back!!!

quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: The boat was fast enough for my daughter to wakeboard and everyone was able to tube. We also tied up at shell island and had time to play. Bluetooth connection to the boat stereo lets you play your favorite sunshine playlist. 6 adults & 1 kid fit comfortably.

quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Our son was home from the army so we rented a 21’ deck boat for the day. We had an awesome time on the water. We were on the water shortly after we arrived. They make renting a boat super easy. We will definitely be back in the near future.

quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Had a great time with the family enjoying a day on the water! The folks at TV boat rentals were fantastic. This is my second or third rental here and we always have a great time. Thanks TV folks!

quotes.author: TripAdvisor
quotes.text: They folks we've worked with have all been very courteous, helpful and kind. We will continue to rent from them in the future.
